name: vam-ai-units
description: Vasyl Marchenko's personal AI units — knowledge-base and session-continuity skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: vam-knowledge
plugins.description: Ticket-bound personal knowledge base — save explanations, message drafts and findings into an Obsidian vault under their ticket, merging on follow-ups, and recall them later by ticket, topic or search. Vault-agnostic — pair it with a vam-vault-* connector.

plugins.name: vam-session
plugins.description: Session continuity — compact a conversation into a handoff document a fresh session, another agent, or a teammate can pick up cold.

plugins.name: vam-vault-kb
plugins.description: Vault connector — mounts the primary knowledge vault as the obsidian-kb MCP server, reading its path from ${VAM_VAULT_KB}.

plugins.name: vam-sdlc
plugins.description: Full SDLC pipeline for Claude Code: a 12-stage ideation-to-ship backbone (map-architecture, PRD, architecture/ADR, data model, API contracts, task DAG, test plan, TDD implementation, review, ship) plus cross-cutting utilities for sizing, glossary, roadmap, UI design specs, live UI verification and end-user documentation. Vendored from genkovich/agentic-engineering-course, MIT.
